'''Daniel Holmes''' (also published as '''Dan Holmes'''; GEMP handle '''Vanvoneer''')<ref name="org2026">Email from Stephen Sanders to 2026 Retro League participants, 2026 (player name / GEMP handle / forum name list).</ref> is a player in the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]]. He was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 31 FL from Kamloops, BC; the slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
